standard: Teaching Standard and Practice v1.12; fixed M101 opening v0.4
scope: 5 questions, 20 parts, 100 marks, 6 separate assessment hours after U08–U10 and formative iCMA03. No deadlines, weights, thresholds or learner records changed.
reviewType: Distinct author subject, reader, visual and whole-assessment review passes. Fresh separate calculations and program executions provide computational cross-checks. This is not independent human review or learner testing.

subject.coverage: All 20 parts have worked private solutions and criterion-level allocations, alternative-method and carried-forward guidance. Open interpretation questions have sample reasoning and criteria.
subject.method: Separate numerical/Fraction/trigonometric checks of motion, energy, propagation, boundary conditions, ray geometry, detector budgets, fixed models and residuals. Invalid data checks and identical CSV/JSON outputs from two clean processes in separate folders. Private specimen plot inspected against tabular output.
corrections: Corrected a rounding error in the private refraction result.
Private lens caption now describes light direction without claiming undrawn arrowheads.
subject.privacy: Full results, worked guide, specimen code, diagrams, output and screenshots remain in restricted sibling work/p101-tma03-private outside repository and publication.

reader.method: Read complete public assessment, check each requested operation against taught sections and worked guide; compare explanatory/practice passages in sources record.
corrections: Explicitly stated thin paraxial lens model.
Made control matching, instantaneous sampling, response scale, nonchronological file order and two group meanings explicit.
Qualified extension beyond eight seconds by continued model validity.
Distinguished display precision from a supplied uncertainty distribution.
Kept common notebook/written explanations cross-referenced, avoiding duplicate submission work.
reader.continuity: Opening connects the block question of patterns versus observations; final handover preserves the transition to fields/potentials. References point to all three completed unit resources.

visual.actualInspection: Public desktop question sections, preparation and handover; private worked question sections; narrow-screen optical diagram, photo, wave and model mathematics, data table and offline copy; dark-mode wave question. Refined displays re-inspected after change.
visual.automatedCases: 10 widths/theme combinations at 1440, 900, 640, 390, 320 px; no-JS; keyboard contents navigation; 200% zoom proxy; offline questions and private guide at 1440/390/320 px; print-media availability. No page overflow, broken internal anchors, duplicate IDs, unloaded images or JavaScript errors.
corrections: Split paired wave and source-model formulas into separate displays for narrow screens.
Added visible narrow-screen diagram-scroll cue; keyboard scrolling reaches right-hand table and diagram content.
Cleaned data readme spacing and explicit source credits.

Final live opening inspection exposed global site-header flex styling: scoped the assessment header to a normal block and added a computed-layout browser assertion. Rebuilt offline copy and rechecked before final release.
visual.math: Semantic inline/display MathML with fractions, radicals, superscripts and delimiters; readable without JS. Larger apparatus diagrams/tables scroll within labelled keyboard-focusable regions.
visual.media: Two original setup diagrams plus licensed original-size kit photograph, contextual caption and reuse record. Existing U10 closing page media warning reviewed: only its assessment handover sentence changed; prior figures and unit illustration programme preserved.
visual.format: Self-contained printable offline HTML with embedded photograph, table and mathematical structure. No separate assessment PDF authored; existing compact unit references remain unchanged.

wholeAssessment.coverage: O3 physical reasoning, O5 controlled interpretation/planning, O6 reproducible programming, O7 evidence and communication; U08 motion/energy/driving, U09 propagation/superposition/boundaries, U10 rays/energy/resolution/records.
wholeAssessment.variety: Routine fluency, explanations, derivation, sketches, diagnostic counterexamples, mixed ratios and original computational investigation. No unstated apparatus competence or new mathematical methods.
wholeAssessment.workload: 15 min preparation + 45/60/55/40/110 min questions + 35 min check/rerun/package = 360 min. Existing B03 54h/8h Python remains intact; feedback uses existing module allocation, reassessment requires separately agreed scope. Author estimate, not timed student validation.
wholeAssessment.balance: No public answer disclosure or model solution code; suitable private guidance is complete. No forced extra lesson exercises or unrelated extension work.

localReleaseChecks.structuralMediaCheck: pass; existing review-page warning editorially considered

limitations: No independent human review or timed learner pilot.
Private OU physics/optics assessment comparator unavailable; inspected OU trigonometry and open undergraduate physics passages used with explicit fit/gaps.
No exact external question matches the combined Q05 computing investigation.
disposition: Locally complete; user-authorised publication may proceed. Hosted security, tests, build and deployment must pass, then verify live content, downloads and browser behaviour before claiming live.
integration: Rebased onto d8153a7 (reviewed M101 revision release); its source and rendered pages remain unchanged. Combined 177 tests and 165-page search rebuilt successfully.
